requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size supporting >8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher page yield reduces frequency of bottle replacement, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink formulation compatibility, bottle design, printer compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must pass validation for 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield; CMY bottle must support >8K pages with no spill or reliability issues.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure ink bottles are designed for spill-free operation during installation and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free bottles reduce mess, increase user satisfaction, and lower support costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spill incidents during standard installation and replacement tests as per HP QA protocols.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (Next-Generation Output Assembly-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, retaining current push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product reliability and supports new ink system requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F component sourcing, assembly line modifications
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units must include metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and pass reliability and compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment ink formulations without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and costs by reusing proven components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink reformulation required; successful integration with new hardware and software.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Performance Modelling
requirements.Description: Conduct reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modelling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL) scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system performance meets quality and longevity targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Comprehensive models and test reports demonstrating compliance with HP standards for reliability and performance.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in tanks and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents print quality degradation and supports warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability model completed with recommendations for PQ maintenance.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as a service part for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and customer satisfaction post-sale.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available as a service part; documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumed authentication/identification technology) on the ink bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security and authenticity of consumables.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All lids feature Acumen 6 and pass authentication tests.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify SA14 production line for NOA-F; add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new product features and ensures efficient manufacturing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line and Orcus 5 modifications completed and validated for production.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design printer to allow customers to replace PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F components.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F without service intervention; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Set and support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product value and supports competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and key components must meet or exceed 80K page life in accelerated testing.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Develop and support SKU 2 with high throughput and high PDL (Page Description Language) under a PaaS (Product as a Service) model.
requirements.Rationale: Expands business model flexibility and market reach.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available for PaaS; meets throughput and PDL specifications.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with an increased tank size; ensure no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity without impacting existing document feeder design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased as specified; ADF remains unchanged and validated.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Utilize EPS foam packaging for the printer and components.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop and vibration tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Ensure product compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel standards for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and sustainability requirements for key markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate increased tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures smooth paper handling and maintains product footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly with new tank design; pass paper handling tests.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize overall printer size for efficiency and market requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product competitiveness and reduces shipping/storage costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product size meets defined benchmarks and market expectations.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display operational and passes usability testing.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform with New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes and implement new tube routing and integration for a four-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports improved ink delivery and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Four-tube platform integrated and validated for reliability.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement service station aerosol management with spit platform changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance issues and improves air quality in service areas.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system operational and passes safety/QA tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable operation and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Updated force model validated in simulation and physical tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased printer page life.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents jams and wear over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path validated for 80K+ pages without increased jam rates.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: Extends printer lifespan and supports warranty/service model.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part replaceable at service centers; documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml K (black) bottles and new xx ml CMY (cyan, magenta, yellow) bottles.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yield and reduces frequency of replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 140ml K and new CMY bottles available and compatible with printer.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (fluidic interface) connection for IDS (Ink Delivery System).
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and serviceability of ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connection system passes reliability and serviceability tests.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Use LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and a single SHAID (Secure Hardware Authentication ID).
requirements.Rationale: Increases security and capacity of ink tank.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI tank integrated with keying and SHAID; passes security and capacity tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management system for IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Improves system reliability and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New algorithm and air management validated in field and lab tests.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithm for printer and ink system.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and serviceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithm passes reliability and usability tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to meet page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality throughout product life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion definition documented and validated in testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU components.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components integrated and pass system validation.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module into the printer platform.
requirements.Rationale: Enables wireless connectivity for users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module operational and passes connectivity tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Dune firmware for printer control.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with hardware and new features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dune firmware operational and passes system tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Incorporate Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Protects device from security threats and ensures compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security passes internal and external security audits.

requirements.Title: High Throughput: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must support print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm), with PDL (Page Description Language) speeds of 25/19ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market expectations for performance in target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm) in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: Business Model: Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Support business models for consumer, SMB, and enterprise segments, including PaaS (Product as a Service).
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports flexible deployment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Products and SKUs tailored for consumer, SMB, and enterprise available and marketed.

requirements.Title: Multi-Path Onboarding and Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Support onboarding and solution paths for Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures smooth onboarding and integration for diverse customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Onboarding and solution paths operational and validated for all segments.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Provide scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support including WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Meets enterprise and SMB requirements for device management and scanning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan and management solutions operational and validated by enterprise users.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with HP software ecosystem and customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers supported and pass compatibility tests.

requirements.Title: Protect SMB Segment and Ink/Laser Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Product must protect HP's micro/SMB segments and safeguard traditional ink/laser profit pool from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Defends HP market share and profitability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market analysis shows maintained or increased share in SMB segment after launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise
requirements.Description: Strategically position LaserJet as lead and PDL as flank in medium and enterprise segments, targeting Epson as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive positioning against key market players.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product positioning and marketing materials reflect strategy; track win rates vs. competitors.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System) profitable share by entering new market segments.
requirements.Rationale: Drives revenue growth and market expansion.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share in new segments increases post-launch.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks into the product platform.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and feature set for target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks integrated and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Schedule Constraint)
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA life is at least 65,000 pages as a non-flexible schedule constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Guarantees component longevity and supports warranty claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes 65K page life in accelerated testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or Defined Page Count
requirements.Description: Support warranty life of 2 years or defined page count as a business optimization.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations and reduces warranty costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Warranty Management, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty policy published and matches product reliability data.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure maintenance box is serviceable to support product longevity.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and maintenance costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is easily accessible and replaceable; validated in service tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Provide solution features tailored to SMB needs (e.g., manageability, connectivity, cost efficiency).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses specific requirements of SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB-specific features operational and validated by pilot customers.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Support hosting of 12K-CMYK as a flexible, lower-priority feature.
requirements.Rationale: Provides future scalability and feature differentiation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 12K-CMYK hosting capability validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Support trade page 6K as a flexible, lower-priority feature.
requirements.Rationale: Provides future flexibility for specific market needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trade page 6K feature validated in system tests.
